summary: Full-stack testing of FixAI (Expo + FastAPI). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passing (auth JWT, Google session endpoint schema, specialists CRUD + search + verify + portfolio, reviews w/ aggregation, upload+signed file download, Gemini-3-flash diagnose end-to-end, conversations + messages, service requests full lifecycle). Frontend: all critical mobile flows verified via Playwright at 390x844 — login (JWT), ES/IT language toggle, home recent diagnoses, diagnosis detail with DIY/specialist choice and step checkoff (0/7 → 1/7), specialists tab chips & search listing 5 seeded specialists, specialist profile with rating/portfolio/reviews, chat send message, request-service modal that creates [REQUEST] message in chat, messages list, profile shows 'Cliente'/'Especialista' role correctly and surfaces 'become specialist' row for clients and 'edit specialist' row for specialists, requests screen with status chips. No red screen errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is one 700-line file; consider splitting into routers (auth, specialists, chat, requests, diagnose) as it grows.
Deprecation warning in frontend console: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated.
/api/auth/session accepts arbitrary session_token from Emergent and stores it; token is also directly placed in Authorization header by client — acceptable per Emergent flow but no revoke on reuse.
specialist_out() mutates the dict in-place via pop(); fine today but risky if the same doc is referenced elsewhere.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data added. Used existing seeded specialists (specialist1..4@fixai.app). Tests create fresh TEST_* client users each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and already covers auth, specialists, reviews, upload+files, diagnose (Gemini call ~15s), conversations, messages, and request lifecycle. Reuse it for regression. Frontend testIDs are comprehensive — see grep testID output. Camera cannot be used on web preview; use the gallery-upload-button or call /api/diagnose directly with base64. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is https://fixmyhome-cam.preview.emergentagent.com and viewport should be 390x844.
